Chapter 570: Chapter 16 A Hundred Years (Subscription Request)

Chapter 570: Chapter 16 A Hundred Years (Subscription Request)

Original Essence Qi deficit… this doesn’t mean that simply consuming Spirit Fruit and other nourishing substances would perfectly replenish it.

At least, by Lin Yuan’s standards, it was far from simple.

But it was also not very difficult.

According to Lin Yuan’s estimate, given the current conditions, it would take at most three or four days to replenish.

By then, with Original Essence Qi back to perfection, Lin Yuan’s cultivation speed would enter a period of explosive growth.

It wasn’t exactly cultivation.

...

It was more about systematically returning to the peak.

“The life of this world, the physical body harbors unimaginable potential…” Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, thinking silently.

In this respect, Lin Yuan had already discovered, at the time of Consciousness Descent, that the original Longshan Yuan was deeply addicted to the company of women; regardless of how weak he appeared, a few days’ rest would almost restore him, hinting at the robustness of his physique.

“Potential, does it come from the bloodline?”

Lin Yuan slightly closed his eyes, feeling it carefully.

Even with such a cursory sensing, he could detect several dozen bloodlines within Longshan Yuan’s body, some of which were faint, probably separated by many years, but among these bloodlines, more than ten were of the Seventh Rank Bloodline.

“It is somewhat similar to those bloodline evolutionary families in the Main Universe…” Lin Yuan mused.

The ‘Knight’ cultivation system of this realm fundamentally involves tapping into the power of bloodlines, such as the Longshan cultivation law, which strengthens one’s power by stimulating the ‘Mountain Dragon’ bloodline within the Longshan Family.

“Too many and too mixed bloodlines, how chaotic was the Longshan Family’s Ancestor?” Lin Yuan slightly shook his head.

The Longshan Family’s ‘Mountain Dragon’ bloodline originated from a dragon beast whose size was akin to mountain ranges; how this dragon beast’s bloodline was integrated into the Longshan Family is also a question.

Most bloodline evolutionary families in the Main World do so by extracting the bloodlines of those unique beings, turning them into Bloodline Potions, and finally integrating these potions with their own bloodlines.

But as for the Longshan Family and many other families, even the Imperial Clan, they do not know.

So far, Lin Yuan has not heard of the concept of ‘Bloodline Potion’ in this realm.

“By tapping into the power of bloodlines, thus the knights of this world cultivate quickly, but of course, their lifespans are also short,” Lin Yuan thought.

Although the bloodline evolutionary families in the Main Universe also delve into their own bloodlines, they supplement their cultivation with other evolutionary paths.

Unlike the knights of this realm, who rely solely on the power of bloodlines.

This limitation leads to a situation where, unless they kindle the divine fire and become Seventh Rank Demigods, even the Sixth Rank legendary knights find it hard to live past a thousand years.

The Fourth and Fifth Rank knights are even more so; living past two hundred years is considered long-lived.

“Not just purely relying on the power of bloodlines, but more like it’s the world rules that are limiting?” Lin Yuan concluded.

No matter how much they relied on the power of bloodlines, after stepping into the Sixth Rank, equivalent to a Sixth Rank Evolver in the Main World, their Life Essence is set, so how could they not live past a thousand years?

The only possibility is the world rules of this realm.

Just like during the eighth transmigration, where the Supreme Immortal Kings of the Spirit Realm could endure epoch after epoch, almost indefinitely, as long as they’re not met with accidents, with life spans far exceeding the Eighth Layer evolvers of the Main World.

This realm is the same.

Unless the divine fire is kindled, lifespans are considerably short.

“However, the lifespans of the Eighth Layer divine beings seem terrifyingly long, in stark contrast to those below the Seventh Layer,” Lin Yuan raised his head again to glance at the sky.

If the Seventh Rank Demigods who have kindled the divine fire still face the possibility of their divine fire extinguishing,

then the Eighth Layer divine beings truly endured throughout the ages, residing either in the Ocean of Light or the Abyss of Darkness, overlooking the mortal realms,

especially those twenty-four Prime Gods who manage parts of the rule’s authority, posed a greater threat to Lin Yuan than Hunyi, the strongest Ninth Rank life form of the Tianyu Clan which had opened over thirty million Spatial Layers.

“Take it slow.”

“This descent has a stay of one thousand one hundred and ten years.”

Lin Yuan was not in a hurry; with the full support of the Longshan Family, as long as Lin Yuan recovered a certain level of power, the subsequent increase in strength would entirely be like a snowball effect.

“It’s just…”

“This world places such importance on bloodlines, the bodily bloodline origins are ancient and mysterious, and the ‘Physical Body Divine Ability’ that emerges from this basis… must not be weak.”

Expectation appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

Physical Body Divine Ability, an exclusive capability of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, awakens divine skills based on the bloodlines within one’s body upon reaching the Sixth Rank.

For other Martial Arts Evolutionaries, they could only awaken one Physical Body Divine Ability in their lifetime, but due to Lin Yuan’s ability descended from the Door to the Myriad Realms, he could awaken one after another.

However, even among Physical Body Divine Abilities, there was a distinction between strong and weak.

The three Physical Body Divine Abilities Lin Yuan currently possessed — Blood Rebirth, Mountain Moving, Strengthening.

Among them, Blood Rebirth and Strengthening were of great help to Lin Yuan, but Mountain Moving… being purely a force-based divine skill, was slightly lesser in utility.

Both in terms of application scope and strength, it was inferior to the previous two.

Given that the descended body had such a rich source of bloodlines, the ultimately awakened Physical Body Divine Ability would likely not be too weak.

…

Longshan Ling.

Longshan City.

This day was a grand occasion for the Longshan Family; it was said that the First Viscount Longshan had established the Longshan Family on this day, hence beginning over two thousand years of absolute dominion over Longshan Ling.

As the third in line for succession in the Longshan Family, Lin Yuan naturally would not be absent during such an important event.

“Big Brother Yuan, today’s sun is so hot… it’s making me feel dizzy, what should we do…” a young girl from the Longshan Family with flushed cheeks said, leaning towards Lin Yuan.
